# Catalogue record

- Title: Adaptive Checkpoint Throttling for Embedded Databases
- Authors: Reyes-Akintola, D.; Sundqvist, M.
- Year: 2022
- Venue: Transactions on Mobile Data Management
- Full text: NOT AVAILABLE. The publisher copy is behind a paywall and was not imported. Only this record is in the project.

## Abstract (from the publisher's listing)
We present a checkpoint scheduler for embedded databases that throttles checkpoint work according to observed write stall time. An evaluation on mobile workloads reports reduced stall time compared with fixed-interval checkpointing.
